task: issue #99 (Refs #59): first cold start of code-intel-pipeline against a foreign, non-self-hosted repository
methodology_note: Built from source per task instructions (cargo build -p code-intel --release --locked) rather than running skills/code-intel-pipeline/SKILL.md's bootstrap.py installer, which would fetch a published GitHub Release instead of exercising this worktree's current code. 'code-intel' was therefore never placed on PATH; every command below invokes the freshly built binary by its full path, shown as $BIN = target/release/code-intel.exe. CODE_INTEL_HOME was exported to the pipeline_worktree path for every step except step 13, which deliberately left it at the machine's ambient value to probe finding F5.

steps.purpose: Task step 1: build the CLI from source in the t4 worktree.
SKILL.md 'Resolve the installation' step 1: confirm `code-intel --help` succeeds before doing anything else.
findings: F1: default --help lists only 6 commands (code-intel ., --mode, doctor --json, graph, resume, sentrux check). None of run execute / run dag-coordinate / artifact query / change risk appear here.

steps.purpose: Only way found to discover run execute / artifact query / change risk short of reading source or CI YAML, since SKILL.md and README never mention them.
findings: F1: the 4 commands this task needed only exist in the 'Advanced commands' full help, which SKILL.md's install-resolution step never instructs a reader to run.

steps.purpose: README's stated replacement for retired legacy/check-code-intel-tools.ps1 ('请用 code-intel doctor'); task step 3 requires doctor first.
findings: Informational: bare `doctor` only returns {artifactRoot, artifactRootExists, ok} -- no rg/git/rust/repowise probing. The richer environment probe lives in the separate, README-unlinked `doctor bootstrap` subcommand. Not numbered as a friction (nothing broke), noted for completeness.

steps.purpose: The actual documented outsider entry point: README '30 秒开始' / SKILL.md 'Run the pipeline' step, verbatim.
findings: Clean run: all 7 DAG nodes (doctor, repo.snapshot, inventory.rg, evidence.native-code, evidence.graph, evidence.sentrux, diagnosis.hospital) reported status=succeeded, verdict=pass. Governance state: green / observe / 'clean snapshot' / next_protocol=post_op.

F3: published output at C:/Users/Administrator/AppData/Local/code-intel/artifacts/tdxcli-rs/<run>/ is a flat objects/sha256/<hash> blob store plus run-complete.json -- no diagnosis.hospital/hospital.md path exists on disk, contra README 'Output在哪里'.

findings: F2: exact error 'no committed authoritative run is indexed for repository: second-repo-scan'.

findings: F2: exact error 'no committed authoritative run is indexed for repository: tdxcli-rs'. Both guesses fail identically; neither --help nor the error message hints at the real cause.

steps.adaptation: Depends on step 09's authority-root nesting adaptation.
findings: F2 resolved: returns real matches (repository.snapshot, code_evidence.symbol_chunks, code_evidence.imports, diagnosis.surgery-plan-view, evidence.admission), confidence='limited' because no --repo-path was supplied for freshness comparison.

steps.purpose: Task step 3's snapshot-identity query surface; also documented in README 'Portable Snapshot Identity'.
findings: Worked exactly as documented. Cross-validated: the reported dirtyOverlay.members.trackedModified list and untracked paths match this task's own BEFORE git-status snapshot of tdxcli-rs byte for byte (7 modified files + .ast-grep/ + .githooks/).

steps.purpose: Task step 3's change-risk query surface on the target repo's recent commits.
steps.adaptation: change risk has no --repo/--repo-path flag (confirmed in --help --all's own usage string); had to cd into the target repo and invoke the pipeline binary by absolute path from inside it instead of passing a flag.
findings: F4: only subcommand touched in this task with no explicit repo-selection flag; resolves the repo from CWD via git::resolve_repo_root(). Once run correctly, returned real per-file churn/bug-fix scoring for 40+ files across HEAD~5..HEAD.

steps.command: $BIN run execute --repo D:/projects/tdxcli-rs --out $TEMP/t4-scan3 --authority-root $TEMP/t4-auth3/tdxcli-rs --final-name run-002-nohome --manifest orchestration/integrations.json --doctor-require-repowise false   (CODE_INTEL_HOME left unset / at machine-ambient value instead of the pipeline_worktree)
steps.purpose: Targeted probe of the task's own 'Why' motivation: CODE_INTEL_HOME-style traps. This machine's default shell carries CODE_INTEL_HOME=D:\projects\code-intel-pipeline (the main checkout) at all times, not any worktree; 11+ worktrees of this repo coexist on this machine per `git worktree list`.
findings: F5: exit 0, no ambiguity error, despite CODE_INTEL_HOME pointing at a different checkout than the one running. Likely because --manifest was passed explicitly (resolves as a plain CWD-relative path in run_cli.rs, never reaching providers.rs's guarded orchestration_manifest()/reject_foreign_checkout resolver). Not isolated further this session -- see frictions.md F5 for caveats.
